brief: The number of failed native module calls in the flushed call aggregate. Only applies to React Native.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the `react_native.module.*` namespace; the SDK emitted the same values under both a singular `turbo_module.*` and a plural `turbo_modules.*` prefix

changelog.description: Added turbo_modules.total_error_count and deprecated it in favor of react_native.module.error.count
